title: Busybox: cpio hardlink target not sanitized under feature_path_traversal_protection
description: CVE-2026-124744 is a vulnerability in Busybox version 3.0 where the cpio hardlink target is not properly sanitized under the feature_path_traversal_protection mechanism. This flaw relates to improper handling of file paths, potentially allowing path traversal issues. No CVSS score or detailed impact information is provided.
